process: Nothing is in progress; the camera spins 360 degrees in place over a static white marble mausoleum in a formal garden.
away_prompt: Broad formal garden on a bright clear day, with wide pale stone walkways running between tall dark cypress trees. Visitors stroll in small groups along the paths, and neatly mown green lawns stretch out to the boundary walls. Beyond the far garden wall, the wide Yamuna river glints faintly through a line of trees under a deep blue sky with a hazy skyline.

sources.fact: The Charbagh garden in front of the tomb is a square divided into four quarters by shallow water channels and fountains, with wide walkways and cypress avenues along the sides.
The mausoleum stands on the right bank of the Yamuna River where the river takes a sharp turn eastwards, so the river lies beyond the tomb rather than at the garden viewpoint.

stages.prompt: A white marble mausoleum with a central onion dome and four surrounding minarets stands at the end of a long blue reflecting pool.
